record.context_brief: Unconditional bases in Lp of the first uncountable product cube
record.original_question: For 1 <= p < infinity with p not equal to 2, does the nonseparable Lebesgue space Lp({-1,1}^{omega_1}) have an unconditional basis? The measure on {-1,1}^{omega_1} is the product probability measure with each coordinate assigning mass 1/2 to -1 and 1/2 to 1.

artifact.category_tag: Unconditional bases in nonseparable Lp spaces
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\omega_1$ denote the first uncountable ordinal. Consider the compact abelian group $\{-1,1\}^{\omega_1}$ (with coordinatewise multiplication) equipped with its normalized Haar measure $\mu$, which coincides with the product probability measure assigning mass $1/2$ to each of $-1$ and $1$ in every coordinate. For a real number $p$ with $1 \le p < \infty$ and $p \neq 2$, let $L_p(\{-1,1\}^{\omega_1}, \mu)$ denote the (nonseparable) Banach space of equivalence classes of $p$-integrable real-valued functions on $\{-1,1\}^{\omega_1}$, with the usual norm $\|f\|_p = (\int |f|^p\, d\mu)^{1/p}$.

Recall that a family $(e_\gamma)_{\gamma \in \Gamma}$ in a Banach space $X$ is an unconditional (Schauder) basis if every $x \in X$ admits a unique representation $x = \sum_{\gamma \in \Gamma} a_\gamma e_\gamma$ that converges unconditionally in norm.

Question: For every $p$ with $1 \le p < \infty$ and $p \neq 2$, does the Banach space $L_p(\{-1,1\}^{\omega_1}, \mu)$ admit an unconditional basis?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether $L_p(\{-1,1\}^{\omega_1})$ has an unconditional basis for $1\le p<\infty$, $p\ne 2$, is recorded as a long-standing open problem in the literature on bases in nonseparable Banach spaces (work of Plichko–Popov and related surveys). No published resolution was located in the search; the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Biorthogonal Systems in Nonseparable Spaces (Hájek–Montesinos–Vanderwerff–Zizler)
status_evidence.snippet: Chapter on long unconditional bases and the structure of nonseparable Lp-type spaces; existence of unconditional bases in nonseparable Lp spaces is discussed as an open question.
status_evidence.claim: The existence of unconditional bases in nonseparable Lp spaces such as Lp({-1,1}^{ω_1}) is treated as open in this monograph.

status_evidence.title: Bases in nonseparable symmetric spaces (Plichko–Popov)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses uncountable unconditional basic sequences and unconditional decompositions in nonseparable symmetric function spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Standard references on bases in nonseparable Lp spaces leave the unconditional basis question for Lp({-1,1}^{ω_1}) unresolved.
